description: Restore truthfulness of the harness self-check: roster parity currently fails for a stale-constant reason, the unmapped-model assertion is structurally unreachable, and no green gate exists to distinguish a regression from the active track's expected Red.
deviation_notes:
Track setup (strategy revision): reconciled the live unmapped-model set against the plan's stated list. Plan Task 2.4 originally listed eight 'currently unmapped references' but only three are actually unmapped at the strategy commit SHA (248d841). The five names not unmapped in live state — measure-mid-red, measure-review-a-correctness, coder-orchestrator, coder-kimi-for-coding-highspeed, coder-kimi-for-coding-k2p7 — were already present in MODEL_MAP at strategy commit time. The live unmapped set is measure-adversarial-testing, measure-ux-browser-review, coder-openai-gpt-5-6-luna-fast. Plan Task 2.4 was rewritten to reconcile against live behavior and to record the discrepancy. Estimated task count corrected from 18 to 19 (the Contract Test Layout section is a planning artifact, not a tracked task; the on-disk count remains 3 phases × 5 tasks + 4 cross-cutting = 19 plan lines).

Phase 2 Green (live state at Phase 2 Red SHA c2ec3ea): live unmapped-model set is 7 agents, not 3 as the strategy text states. The strategy was committed at SHA 7fe1a95 against baseline 248d841; between the strategy commit and the Phase 2 Red commit, the user made dirty edits to four additional agent files (coder-kimi-for-coding-highspeed, coder-kimi-for-coding-k2p7, coder-openai-gpt-5-6-luna-fast, coder-orchestrator) that introduced kimi-for-coding/* and openai/gpt-5.6-luna-fast references. Live unmapped count at c2ec3ea: 7 (coder-kimi-for-coding-highspeed, coder-kimi-for-coding-k2p7, coder-openai-gpt-5-6-luna-fast, coder-orchestrator, measure-adversarial-testing, measure-review-a-correctness, measure-ux-browser-review). All 7 are well-formed provider/id; all 7 classify as `map_entry_needed`; 0 classify as `reference_incorrect`. Reconciliation report committed at measure/tracks/harness_selfcheck_truthfulness_20260805/reconciliation-models.md. Per spec 'Out of Scope: Changing which model any agent is routed to,' MODEL_MAP routing changes are NOT made in this track — the user-pending routing decision is recorded here as Decision-Required.

Cross-cutting C3 (scope decision under the active plan's execution policy, recorded at HEAD f914e2bd48dc4790d698bd4551d1eab3814a71eb): this track was authorized as a follow-on repair under the active controlled_harness_evolution_20260714 track's execution policy. The active plan is at S1 stalled at Red (S1.3 [~], S1.3b [~]); the false doctor signal is live today. The scope of this follow-on was deliberately bounded: defect repair on the shipped self-check surface, NOT a duplicate of S1's mechanism (versioned manifest, hash-drift, preflight). Spec Out-of-Scope rule: 'Building the versioned release manifest, hash-drift detection, or preflight blocking surface. Those are owned by controlled_harness_evolution_20260714 Phase S1 (Tasks S1.2, S1.4) and must not be duplicated here.' The scope decision authorizes this track to install four guards (roster-derived parity replacing hardcoded 24/22 constants in lib/core.mjs#rosterParity; strict model resolution in lib/core.mjs#parseAgentFile removing the ?? sourceModel passthrough; structured unmappedModelFindings with suggestion field in lib/core.mjs#agentParity; green gate independent of active-track Red via npm run test:shipped + tests/.track-red-files.txt classifier). Each guard is superseded by S1 (see handoff.md at measure/tracks/harness_selfcheck_truthfulness_20260805/handoff.md for the explicit guard-to-supersede mapping). The reconciliation-models.md report at measure/tracks/harness_selfcheck_truthfulness_20260805/reconciliation-models.md is a Decision-Required artifact for the user. MODEL_MAP routing changes are NOT made in this track (spec Out-of-Scope: 'Changing which model any agent is routed to. Correcting the roster's model references is a separate decision requiring the user's routing intent, not a defect fix.'); the user's routing intent for the 7 live unmapped agents (coder-kimi-for-coding-highspeed, coder-kimi-for-coding-k2p7, coder-openai-gpt-5-6-luna-fast, coder-orchestrator, measure-adversarial-testing, measure-review-a-correctness, measure-ux-browser-review — all classified map_entry_needed) is pending. Critical rule carried into handoff.md: DO NOT coexist two parity mechanisms; when S1 lands and acceptance passes, the active track's acceptance must retire this track's mechanism, not leave both live.

sprint.goal: Make a red doctor mean something again: every self-check finding names a concrete, currently-true defect, and a regression in a shipped surface is visible while a track is mid-flight.
